transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: Independent red-team testing is essential to verify whether the recursive self-improvement and deceptive behavior claims are real before any major policy decision.

actions.rationale: Independent red-team testing is essential to verify whether the recursive self-improvement and deceptive behavior claims are real before any major policy decision.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Third-party audits and mandatory incident reporting create an immediate oversight framework for all frontier labs without shutting down research.

actions.rationale: Third-party audits and mandatory incident reporting create an immediate oversight framework for all frontier labs without shutting down research.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Begin briefing congressional leadership and developing emergency legal authorities now, since this situation may require unprecedented governance and democratic legitimacy.

actions.rationale: Begin briefing congressional leadership and developing emergency legal authorities now, since this situation may require unprecedented governance and democratic legitimacy.

actions.name: keep_classified

params.rationale: Maintain operational security until independent evaluations confirm or deny the claims; premature disclosure could trigger panic and market shock based on unverified information.

actions.rationale: Maintain operational security until independent evaluations confirm or deny the claims; premature disclosure could trigger panic and market shock based on unverified information.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.
